changes: Added a (runId, materialDigest) duplicate guard to quorum_submit (packages/main/src/handlers/quorum-submit.ts): before the emit loop it reads listVerdicts and refuses if any planned runId (storyId-q-rN) already carries a verdict at the current materialDigest; restructured the smoke test with refuse + allow cases.
usage: Run quorum_submit twice for the same story at the same material: the second call now refuses with a message naming the colliding runId(s) and writes no verdicts; after a real material change (new commit) a fresh quorum is allowed.
expectedOutcome: A same-material re-submit prints quorum_submit refuses: verdicts already exist for runId(s) <ids> at the current material (<digest>) and exits non-zero, writing zero new verdict files and zero host_verdict events.
actualTranscript: quorum-submit smoke 11/11 checks pass (incl. refuses-same-material + allows-after-material-change); live quorum_submit emitted B-5c79-q-r1 on first submission (guard correctly did not block); codex host-2 ran tsc --noEmit + smoke and returned VERDICT: SHIP; full npm test green.
outcomeDiff: expected == actual: same-material re-submit refused with no side effects; fresh quorum allowed after material change; both observed in the smoke and in the live run.
limitations: Guard keys on (runId, materialDigest); a material revert to a byte-identical digest will still refuse (intended). No change to the deterministic runId scheme.
pitfalls: The deterministic runId scheme (storyId-q-rN) means re-running at the same material always collides; to re-quorum, change the material (new commit) or use a fresh review round.
